description: Core mathematics for computer science: set theory, relations and functions, sequences and series, vectors, matrices and linear algebra, calculus and graph theory, applied through Python programming.
Fundamental computing concepts including logic and Boolean algebra, computer architecture, number systems, the command line, data processing, digital communications, computer security and databases.

Creating interactive 3D applications and environments with games technology, while developing academic skills such as literature searching, academic writing, critical analysis, referencing and group work.
How modern software applications are structured and exchange data over the web through HTTP services, with an introduction to database concepts and technologies.
An introduction to an industry-standard object-oriented language such as Java, C# or C++, covering object-oriented programming, common data structures and algorithms.

The principles common to modern programming languages: problem solving, algorithm design, variables and data types, logic, the basics of object orientation, testing and debugging, and simple data structures.
Algorithm design, data structures and mathematical notation, moving from single-threaded programs to concurrency, including multi-threading, deadlocks and race conditions.
Developing a software artefact in a team, covering team roles, collaboration and development techniques, project management tools, documentation and information security.
Tools and techniques for full stack web development: secure, dynamic websites using a server-side scripting language and a database, plus front-end interface design and implementation.
Object-oriented design and programming in Java, including encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism, modelling, version control, testing, documentation and secure design.
A range of cloud technologies, leading to a system that is developed for and deployed to cloud infrastructure.
The principles of modern networks and the internet, with practical work setting up and configuring switches and routers.
An overview of the tools, techniques and applications of artificial intelligence, including building a practical AI solution and researching current innovations.
Data processing and mining techniques and tools, including the knowledge discovery process, collecting and processing varied data, and social web mining.
Creating games and interactive applications with an industry-standard programming language and game engine, covering input, physics, animation, AI and mathematics for games.
The concepts, theories and practices of big data, including distributed systems and current techniques for processing and managing large data sets.
Professional, social, legal and ethical issues in computing in line with BCS guidelines, plus the individual final year project with a proposal, literature review and regular supervisor meetings.
In-depth full stack web application development, with emphasis on architectural patterns, service-oriented architectures and emerging web technologies.

module_name: Advanced Games and Interactive Applications Development
description: More advanced game and interactive application development, such as AI for games, multiplayer and mobile games, and mathematics and programming for games.
Current and emerging artificial intelligence and machine learning in domestic and commercial settings, with a portfolio of work in a chosen area.
The theory and concepts of intelligent systems that use AI to perceive and respond to the world, the issues in creating them, and the chance to build one.
Designing, implementing and testing applications for mobile platforms, including the tools, techniques and security issues involved.
Software engineering theory and practice: maintaining and extending a legacy system with reverse engineering, regression testing, refactoring and design patterns, plus emerging techniques.
